assumptions.statement: Official polygons, regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal, fire, heritage and engineering constraints are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: All spatial and implementation moves remain conceptual and must be recalculated or redesigned after official data review.

assumptions.statement: Three TOD nodes are located conceptually at the centers of the repository provisional key areas, not surveyed station entrances.
assumptions.impact: 5/10/15-minute rings are design heuristics; official station entrances and walking-network surveys must replace them.

assumptions.statement: No audited pedestrian network, crossing delay, barrier, accessibility or night-safety baseline is available.
assumptions.impact: Performance targets remain survey items and no travel-time improvement is claimed.

assumptions.statement: TOD value uplift may displace ordinary residents, workers and small businesses unless protections precede development.
assumptions.impact: Affordable rental housing, basic retail and small-business safeguards are treated as mandatory policy directions, subject to legal review.
